interpretation: Two independently specified distribution objectives can agree on a strong, bounded appearance match, but their agreement does not exclude a shared content-distribution shortcut. Canonicalizer consensus is therefore a necessary sensitivity diagnostic, not a sufficient authorization gate.
allowed_next: test a frozen content-cell-balanced worst-case appearance gate using content identities that are independent of colour appearance

forbidden: tighten the 0.06 disagreement threshold after observing the failed confound
add a third distribution loss or larger flow as a rescue
train on current stock pixels or promote a product renderer
